scope: First end-to-end review of the Linux DAW pipeline; SDK targets checked for prerequisites.

steps.step: Check and bootstrap the pinned tools
Export the shared delay to all target source packages
Compile Linux CLAP and VST3 binaries

steps.result: passed with one retained timing warning

steps.step: Run compiled DSP and pipeline regressions
Load and render CLAP and VST3 in a private REAPER instance

issues.fix: Reject truncated state and require a complete parameter section before accepting it. Apply a reproducible, hash-checked patch to the generated DPF copy.
issues.status: fixed; malformed-state and normal state round trips pass

issues.issue: Very small floating-point values can increase CPU use
issues.fix: Enable the compiler-provided scoped denormal handling. Verify audio-only performance and restoration of host settings.
issues.status: mitigated; audio-only ratio 1.032; broad validator still emits one timing warning. Its timing also includes random test-data generation, so this is not a clean measurement of plugin work alone.

issues.issue: CLAP and VST3 expose parameter scales differently to the test script
issues.fix: Set normalized parameter values in the REAPER regression script.
issues.status: fixed; both formats render the same 100/150 ms echoes and 0.5 feedback

issues.issue: Initial REAPER test windows interrupted the desktop
issues.fix: Run REAPER on a private Xvfb display with private preferences; disable any desktop fallback. Disable GLX for the virtual server to avoid a local graphics-driver startup failure.
issues.status: fixed; final host tests ran without desktop windows

issues.issue: Wwise and Unreal SDKs are not installed
issues.fix: Keep these targets explicitly marked not built; preserve source packages and exact prerequisite failures.
issues.status: external prerequisite remains; no compatible latest UE/Wwise pair has been verified

review_notes: Internal Linux review build, not a Windows build or a production release. No real Wwise, Unreal Header Tool, MetaSound-host or map-travel tests have been performed.
